caption: The drawing depicts a detailed technical layout of a child's high chair made of maple and ash, rendered in black ink on a light beige background. At the top left, there is a top-view diagram of the chair's seat labeled "RUSH SEAT," showing a square seat with hatched lines that converge in a corner, bounded by four circular shapes representing the corners of the chair. To the right, inside a rectangular border, the label reads "CHILD'S HIGH CHAIR. MAPLE & ASH." Below this, two elevations of the chair are presented: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. The front view shows the chair is 15 inches wide, has turned posts, two horizontal slats forming the backrest, a woven seat, a wooden footrest, and another lower stretcher or support. The side view shows the chair depth as 11 inches, with the back legs extending higher than the front to form the backrest posts, and a height of 36 1/4 inches from the floor to the top of the back posts, as indicated by an arrow with the dimension labeled alongside. At the bottom right is the signature “I. B. SOVENSKY.” The composition is organized neatly, with ample spacing between diagrams and labels, all of which are hand-drawn in fine black lines.
title: High Chair
